maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from natural gas, propane and electricity distribution and pipeline transmission, which are energy deliveries, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are households, businesses and industrial users paying for natural gas, propane and electricity; not mainly government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through regulated utility rate base, pipeline expansions and organic projects; propane tuck-ins are occasional rather than the main growth driver.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated natural gas distribution and pipeline transmission provide essential heating and energy under franchises; customers can't easily switch.
